payload.label: Dictation text and dictionary
payload.job: Turn dictated words into clean text for the app the person is in (spoken commands, the app's style, their dictionary and snippets), give the hearing prompt that biases recognition, learn from the person's edit, and keep their dictionary, snippets and dictation history
payload.description: Give action: clean (text, context, entry_id?; polish or command are asked of the model server on this computer (the dictation-polish job of tool:ask-a-model's models) and leave the text as it was when none answers), bias (context), learn (inserted, final, entry_id?), add (from and to, or kind: snippet with says and expands_to), list, edit (id and fields), delete (id), history, or erase (entry_id, or all). The rows and the history are kept in the folder the person granted. Putting text at the cursor is tool:type-dictated-text.

context.description: app (the app the person is in), names (list or people names around the cursor), screen_text (text the caller chose to give)

input.text: hello from ada example um period

payload.label: Type dictated text at the cursor
payload.job: Put dictated text where the person's cursor is as one clipboard transaction (save, write, paste, restore, verify), never pasting over a clipboard it cannot put back, and note the dictation in their bounded history
payload.description: Give text (cleaned by tool:dictate) and entry_id and context.app when known. Returns entry_id, kind (inserted-verified, inserted-unverified, blocked or failed) and saved, wrote, pasted, restored, verified and error.

context.description: app (the app the person is in), names (list or people names around the cursor), screen_text (text the caller chose to give)
